_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score having moved ±2+ points in 0 of 61 recent 12h windows and the analyst's required breakers (ETF flows >30, MVRV Z >30) not yet present, this is a confirmed coil where HOLD is the statistically honest default — the narrative's bullish setup is noted but unconfirmed by flow data.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken internals and a 0% directional hit rate; narrative implies UP with 0.78 confidence citing accumulation divergence. The split is fundamental: one sees a stall, the other sees a bottom.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND MVRV Z-score climbs above 30, which would shift the phase to Hope and upgrade signal to LONG.
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows go net-negative AND MVRV Z-score drops below 20, which would drop the phase to Panic and downgrade signal to REDUCE.
